transcripts.text: Nearly all the farmers reported that they spent a lot of time and effort trying to frighten off the birds of prey without actually harming them.
Most of the farmers had at least one dog, and said this was a big help at scaring away the predators.

transcripts.text: Some of the farmers also reported that during the breeding season, when the chickens were particularly vulnerable, they encouraged their children to watch over the chickens and to hit pans with a metal spoon, so that the resulting noise would succeed in driving away birds that were trying to seize the young chicks.
